description: Document to clean markdown for AI agents, $0.05 per file: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, ODS, CSV, HTML or XML in, LLM-ready markdown (or plain text) out. One call: send a url or the file as base64 (max 10 MB) — no upload step, no polling. A PDF without a text layer (a scan) returns 400 and you pay nothing; use /doc/ocr for images. USDC on Base, no account, no API key.

file_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded. Send this OR url.

filename.description: Optional original filename of file_base64 (its extension helps detect the type)

max_chars.description: Truncate the output to this many characters

media_type.description: Optional MIME type of file_base64 (helps tell DOCX/XLSX apart)

url.description: http(s) link to the file; we fetch it. Send this OR file_base64.

name: doc_to_markdown
